plain: To openly admit or declare something.

webster.text: To declare openly, with a view to justify, maintain or defend; or simply to own, acknowledge or confess frankly; as, a man avows his principles or his crimes.

example.quote: The only way to stop the passions of men in their career is, coolly to state facts, and deliberately to avow the truth — and to do this we are frequently forced into a painful view of men and measures.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter VI, Dec. 25, 1787
